qa_pairs.question: Which component has the lowest torque specification in the fuel supply section?
qa_pairs.answer: Electric connections on fuel pump with M4 screws at 1.2 Nm

qa_pairs.question: Which fuel pump components share the same 6.5 Nm torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The pump assembly to metal-bonded mount and holder to fuel pump or fuel reservoir both use 6.5 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What is the torque difference between M4 and M5 electric connections on the fuel pump?
qa_pairs.answer: The M5 connections use 1.6 Nm while M4 connections use 1.2 Nm, a difference of 0.4 Nm
